# Plotting with Plotters

Plotters renders vector figures for notebook output, similar to matplotlib in Jupyter. Mars displays the SVG MIME representation directly.

```rust
use plotters::prelude::*;
```

```rust
let figure = plotters::evcxr::evcxr_figure((640, 480), |root| {
    root.fill(&WHITE)?;

    let mut chart = ChartBuilder::on(&root)
        .caption("Sine wave", ("sans-serif", 28))
        .margin(12)
        .x_label_area_size(30)
        .y_label_area_size(36)
        .build_cartesian_2d(0.0_f64..10.0, -1.0_f64..1.0)?;

    chart.configure_mesh().draw()?;
    chart.draw_series(LineSeries::new(
        (0..=200).map(|step| {
            let x = step as f64 / 20.0;
            (x, x.sin())
        }),
        &RED,
    ))?;

    Ok(())
});

figure.evcxr_display();
```
